column3: Three of our server actions (createWorkspace, importRepo, retryBuild) each copy-paste about 60 lines that spin up a sandbox, clone the repo, detect the package manager and run install. A bug fix in one didn't reach the others. How should I split this into actions vs a shared service layer, and in what order should I migrate?

The spacing on our blog index feels off: every section uses the same 24px padding, cards in the grid are all identical, the sidebar crowds the main column, and the headings don't stand out from the body. Fix the layout, spacing system and visual rhythm.

Design 3 banner options for our product launch: a Twitter/X header (1500x500), a LinkedIn cover (1584x396) and an Instagram story (1080x1920). Headline "Payroll for the Gulf, finally simple", CTA "Join the waitlist", brand navy #12355B. Give me different art directions and export them as PNGs.

비평해줘: our mobile checkout screen has the total price in 12px gray (#9ca3af) on white, the "Pay now" and "Edit cart" buttons look identical, there is no error state for a declined card, and our brand guide says primary is #1a56db but the button uses #2563f0. Check it against the brand system too, and reply in English.
